operations.command: set -e; systemctl start immutability-marker.service 2>/dev/null || true; test ! -e /zzz-diff-canary && printf clean
NIXOSCTL_ASSUME_ROOT_FOR_TESTS=true nixosctl diff 2>&1 | grep -q zzz-diff-canary && printf present || printf absent
set -e; mkdir -p /zzz-diff-canary && dd if=/dev/zero of=/zzz-diff-canary/marker bs=4096 count=16 status=none && sync && printf made

NIXOSCTL_ASSUME_ROOT_FOR_TESTS=true nixosctl diff 2>&1 | grep -q zzz-diff-canary || exit 1; if [ "$(nixosctl eval config.settings.disk.immutability.base | tr -d '\"')" = empty ]; then NIXOSCTL_ASSUME_ROOT_FOR_TESTS=true nixosctl persistence materialize --refresh-clean 2>&1 | grep -qF 'no CLEAN snapshot to refresh' || { echo 'refresh-clean was not refused'; exit 1; }; fi; printf detected
